pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Get $(bold)Molten Durandal$() by smelting a $(l:relics/relic_durandal_shard)Durandal's Broken Blade$() in the Smeltery (dropped by killing the Wither)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Durandal (1 ingot) to make Durandal material$(br2)Tier: $(bold)Special (T99)$() - a legendary material.$(br2)$(bold)Castable parts$(): $(l)head$() (Small Blade / Broad Blade / Large Plate), $(l)handle$() (Tool Handle / Tough Handle) and $(l)binding$() (Tool Binding / Tough Binding) - so a tool made $(bold)entirely of Durandal$() is possible (this material cannot be used at the Part Builder; pour Molten Durandal at the $(bold)Casting Table$()).

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_unbreakable)Unbreakable$() (tconstruct:unbreakable): the tool can never be damaged$(br2)Durandal can also be forged straight into a $(l:tools/tool_durandal_sword)Durandal Sword$() - a legendary weapon that never breaks.
